scripts.fonts:sync: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const src=p.resolve('..','fonts');const dest=p.resolve('public','fonts');fs.mkdirSync(dest,{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync(src).filter(n=>/\.otf$/i.test(n)))fs.copyFileSync(p.join(src,f),p.join(dest,f));console.log('fonts synced')"
